scope: CPU native MuJoCo static geometry comparison; no learned policy, dynamics integration or online sensing

cache.provenance: Local verification cache requested for this audit; not the remote training/evaluation cache

geometry_model.construction: build_geometry_model from tools/experiments/cat_geometry_audit.py: production build_cat_cfg, native Scene, production _box_spec, cfg.sim.mujoco.apply, CPU mj_forward

limitations: Frozen default joint poses only; this is not learned-policy performance or measured episode-fall causality.
Known complete scene AABBs are privileged offline geometry, not online perception.
Native mj_geomDistance/contact distances identify actual static penetration; negative cover clearance is a conservative warning and does not alone certify contact.
All obstacle entities use production native collision shapes; sensor attachments are omitted, so compiled model identity is not a checkpoint physical contract.
Source 11-point SDF comes from the requested verified local 4 cm cache and source interpolation; its minima are not exact full-body separation.
Clear starting/goal poses do not prove a dynamically feasible traversal or successful stopping.
